title: Bring the office online
summary: Two PCs, a switch and a router, still in their boxes.

devices.config:
interface s0/1/0
 ip address 10.0.0.2 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown

tasks.text: Plug a **console** cable from PC-A's COM1 into R1's CONSOLE port, then double-click R1.
tasks.hint: Pick Console in the tray. The CONSOLE port has a light-blue outline.

tasks.text: On R1, give `G0/0/0` the address `192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0` and bring it up.
Cable R1 G0/0/0, PC-A and PC-B to S1 with straight-through cables.

tasks.hint: Double-click PC-B. Its network settings are at the top of its window.

tasks.text: From PC-B, `ping 192.168.10.1`. Watch S1's port lights first: amber means spanning tree is still listening.
tasks.hint: If the ping fails, wait for S1's lights to turn green, or set `spanning-tree portfast` on the PC ports.
